component.name: Apple Dev
component.summary: Build, run and ship iPhone apps from Linux

description.p: A native Pantheon window for omarchy-apple-dev, the toolkit that builds SwiftUI and Flutter apps for iPhone on Linux without a Mac or an Xcode install.

ul.li: Toolchain: see what is installed, install or repair it, and sign in with an Apple ID.
Devices: connected iPhones, pairing, details, live logs and installs over Tailscale.
Projects: build, run, debug with LLDB, make App Store builds and upload to TestFlight.

description.p: Every command runs in the built-in Activity terminal, so prompts and passwords work as in a terminal.
